method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 49140, retrieved 7 September 2026); no compilation number stated; latest amendment in the compilation table (Community Protection (Offender Reporting) Amendment Act 2024 Pt 3 Div 2 Subdiv 4) in force 31 December 2025; last reprint listed Reprint 7 as at 1 June 2018; uncommenced Young Offenders and Prisons Legislation Amendment Act 2024 Pt 3 not shown; no regulations set a number used

checks.command: l4 run yoa-cases-diversion.l4 ; l4 run yoa-diversion.l4 ; l4 run yoa-qa.l4 ; l4 run yoa-qa-cases.l4 ; l4 check yoa-qa.l4
checks.result: 379 assertions satisfied (70 baseline + 309 Q&A layer), 0 errors, 0 warnings in all four files; l4 check yoa-qa.l4: Check succeeded; parameter script: 48 questions, my role first in each, every shared parameter identical in type and @desc, each situation straight after the role, no DEONTIC or EVENT input; at most 1,024 yes/no and choice combinations after the role in any question (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 3, 4 (young person, independent young person), 14 (records), 22A, 22B, 22, 23, 23A (cautions), 25, 26, 27, 29 (referral to a juvenile justice team), 30-32, 37A, 38, 40, 62 (the team), 33 (effect of completing the terms), 41 (police options), 55, 60, 66, 67, 69-71 (conviction recording and sentence kinds), 189, 190 (when a youth conviction stops counting)
seat: the young person dealt with by police (Jake at 15)

roles: I am, or was, a young person dealt with by police for an offence
I am a parent or other responsible adult of a young person dealt with for an offence
I am the victim of an offence by a young person
I would publish or pass on information about someone else's matter

situation_parameters.name: the matter was referred to a juvenile justice team
questions: Must I be released when sent to a team
Can the team go ahead
What happens at the team
May the team's terms include it
May a lawyer represent me at my team
What is the most a publisher who identifies me can be fined, for me
Am I a Crown worker doing the team's work
Can I still be charged after the team
What must a court do after the team
Can the team go ahead without me
Must the team have my agreement to how it deals with the matter
Must the team tell me its determination, as the responsible adult
What happens if I withdraw my agreement
May a lawyer represent me at my child's team
Must the team let me take part
Can the team deal with the matter without my agreement
Must the team tell me its determination, as the victim
Can the team order restitution to me
Can the young person undertake restitution to me
May a lawyer represent me at the team, as the victim
What happens to a later charge

situation_parameters.name: I was cautioned
questions: Must I get a caution certificate

situation_parameters.name: how it ended
situation_parameters.does_not_arise: for Am I treated as convicted: every value but a finding of guilt without a conviction recorded; for Has my conviction stopped counting and May someone else disclose my conviction: every value but a finding of guilt with a conviction recorded
questions: Am I treated as convicted
Has my conviction stopped counting
May someone else disclose my conviction
also_ordinary_input_of: Does the Department keep a record
Is there a conviction to spend
Does the Department keep a record of my child's matter
